capabilityLimits: Applies when no external users require backward compatibility, coordinated breaking changes are acceptable and the new API simplifies a refactor.
Edits require authorization and writes; actual checks require execution.
Unavailable writes or execution allow a reduced proposal; missing caller evidence or unresolved applicability blocks safe deletion claims.
Invocation metadata is preserved without assuming host enforcement.
Host behavior has not been tested.
inputs: Agreed new contract, source and caller usage evidence
name: principle-migrate-callers-then-delete-legacy-apis
ordinaryExample: Inventory callers of an internal request API, move them to the new contract, update contract tests and delete the old API in one reviewed unit.
outputs: Coordinated caller migration, legacy API removal and updated contract tests
Reduced proposal or explicit block when required capabilities or evidence are missing
purpose: Migrate internal callers and delete the old API in the same refactor wave.
triggers: Introducing a new internal API while old callers still exist
